note: Locked numbers for scripts/gate.ts. `target`/`tol` is a regression band; `max`/`min` is a hard bound. `nfl` is the real-world number the sim is aiming at and is informational only. Tolerances are deliberately wide enough that moving a metric TOWARD its nfl value never fails the gate. WORKERS MUST NOT EDIT THIS FILE. Every `nfl` value must trace to a computation in docs/nfl-reference.md — changing a baseline is a decision, and decisions go to the orchestrator. Re-lock with `npm run gate:lock`.
